name: Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

payment_behaviour.note: last 12m: 0 of 46 invoices paid >3 days late, max 3 days. We pay on time; no payment grievance to repair.

financial_health.signal: Large AG group, stable credit (147 both years); no financial pressure.

notes: Asks avg 3.9% on increases, settles ~2.6 pp lower (2026: 7.5 kW asked 4.7%, settled 1.2%; EV-2026-70510-350011).
Every settlement since 2023 ended at or below 1.4% (EV-2025-70510-350011, EV-2026-70510-350010).

situation: Group motor maker (EUR 1.38 bn turnover, we are 0.23%) asking +6.5% on the 7.5 kW motor from 2027-01-01 (EUR 348.32 -> 370.96), citing copper and electronic components. Notice is valid (109 vs 90 days, ctr:4600070510#3.1). The copper part of the story is true: CU-NOTATION +47.7% Sep25->Sep26 and cost drivers imply ~+8.5% since the Nov-2025 renewal, so the ask is below index logic and below our should-cost (EUR 374.95). Leverage is procedural, not factual: moves above 2% need a pricing committee.

pressures.evidence: Price changes >2% need pricing-committee approval (meets every two weeks); a <=2% deal lets the KAM close alone.
Real copper cost push: CU-NOTATION 872.3 -> 1288.6 EUR/100kg (+47.7%); motor copper weight ~0.20.

what_it_values: recovering copper cost (they are not hedged, unlike Vesmo)

likely_tradeables.give: accept an increase at or just under 2% (~EUR 355)
likely_tradeables.why: 2% is the KAM's self-approval line; history settles ~2.6 pp under ask
they bear unhedged copper risk; a symmetric clause can fall back if copper eases

arguments_that_should_land.argument: An IE3 motor contains no electronic components; only copper, steel and labour drive its cost, so the electronics part of the letter does not apply.
arguments_that_should_land.why: strips half the justification without denying copper

arguments_that_should_land.argument: Our 7.5 kW forecast is up 11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09): more volume to the same frame.
Two-year record: OTD 90.4% in 2026Q3 is below the 95% target in ctr:4600070510#6.1.
arguments_that_should_land.why: soft quality lever for ppm/chargeback terms

arguments_to_avoid.argument: Copper has not risen / index does not support the increase
arguments_to_avoid.why: false: CU-NOTATION +47.7% yoy; would be contradicted and cost trust
EUR 374.95 is ABOVE their current and asked price; it supports them

persona.who_writes: Key account manager in sales; pricing committee above 2%
persona.style: formal, polite form letters ('we regret this step')
persona.relationship_notes: long reliable supply since 2019/2020, green A-supplier, we pay on time

noise: duplicate annual-review notes M1/M2 say the same thing
